item.title: October Lantern 0.6.18
item.description:
Fixes

  • Answering Claude's questions from Lantern works when the question shows a draft beside its options (a script, a layout). Before, Lantern said Sent but the answer didn't go in.
  • Lantern now says Sent only once the agent's question has closed. If it's still open, the card says "Not sure it went in" so you can check.
  • An agent waiting on one of Lantern's cards keeps waiting if Lantern quits or updates, instead of giving up after a few seconds.

Simpler menus

  • The menu bar icon (the tray on Windows and Linux) now has just the ways in: what's waiting on you, Ask Lantern, Point & Ask, Hide Lantern, Settings and Quit. Right-clicking the lantern shows the same short list.
  • Routines has its own tab beside Waiting and Agents.
  • Report a Problem (Settings › About) sends Lantern's logs and opens an email with their code, so there's one button instead of two.

The Windows installer isn't code-signed yet: if Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", click More info, then Run anyway.
